songs.title: L'Arabesque
songs.blurb: Op. 100 no. 2, complete. A real study: fast five-finger runs over left-hand chords.

songs.title: Prelude in C
songs.blurb: Well-Tempered Clavier, book 1, complete. One broken-chord pattern, 35 bars, no tune at all.

songs.title: In the Hall of the Mountain King
songs.blurb: Grieg's own piano version, the first statement. It starts in the cellar of the keyboard.

songs.title: The Entertainer
songs.blurb: Introduction and first strain from the 1902 edition. Octaves in the right hand, stride in the left.

songs.title: Für Elise
songs.blurb: The whole first section as Beethoven wrote it, from the 1888 Breitkopf edition.

songs.title: Gymnopédie No. 1
songs.blurb: The first half, as written. Slow, bare, and harder to play evenly than it looks.

songs.title: Clair de Lune
songs.blurb: The opening section, bars 1 to 26, in D flat as written, from the 1905 first edition.
